ruling: DEBTORS_DOCTRINE.md D20 — registers declare; discovery only contradicts. Operator ratification in-session: "yes to all recommendations", 2026-09-29.
description: Canonical skill registry — every agent skill file in the repo, its lane, what it is canonical for, the scripts it drives, and the SLICE_REGISTRY slices it produces. Declared by hand; verified against the filesystem by render_skill_registry.mjs.

roots..agents/skills: Primary skill root. Read by Cursor and by agents given repo access.
roots..claude/skills: Claude Code skill root. Loaded only by that runtime.
roots.docs/skills: Legacy prose role descriptions. No frontmatter — not loadable as skills.
roots.analysis/debtors: Account-local reconciliation skills under {CODE}/docs/. Emptied 2026-09-29 by operator decision D3 — FAM000 and JEN001 moved to .agents/skills. Still scanned deliberately: a new account-local skill placed here must trip NO_ORPHAN_FILES rather than sit undiscovered.

kinds.worker: Executes a recon lane turn-by-turn against one account or account family.
kinds.generator: Drives a script that emits registered slices from evidence.
kinds.orchestrator: Dispatches other skills; owns portfolio-level triage and queueing.
kinds.gate: Verification-only. Rejects unsafe conclusions; emits no financial truth.
kinds.human-role: Defines a human operator role and the checklists it executes.
kinds.role-prompt: Software-delivery role definition (PM/QA/coding). Not a recon skill.
kinds.reference: Architecture or decision record. Read for context, never executed.
kinds.account-local: Scoped to one account; not portfolio doctrine.

lanes.platform: The React/Vite app and its architecture.

statuses.active: In force. Safe to load and follow.
statuses.unregistered: File carries no frontmatter, so no agent runtime can auto-load it. Reachable only by explicit path. Deliberate for role prompts and reference docs.
statuses.superseded: Replaced by another record. Retained per the amendments-append rule; name: removed so it cannot be auto-loaded.

retired_statuses.duplicate: Retired 2026-09-29 by DEBTORS_DOCTRINE.md D20. Two files sharing one skill name is no longer a tolerable state — NAME_UNIQUE is a hard gate, so a collision must be resolved rather than acknowledged.

skills.name: debtors-orchestrator
skills.canonical_for: Portfolio triage, worker dispatch per recon lane, payer class taxonomy (§4), human task queueing, evidence-doctrine write gating.
skills.not_for: Executing a single account's recon — dispatch a worker instead.
skills.notes: Holds the payer class taxonomy in prose §4, duplicated in DEBTORS_ORCHESTRATION_PRD.md §6. Drift risk staged as D6 in the registers plan.

skills.name: lsr-debtors-pm
skills.canonical_for: Debtor micro-project lifecycle — status updates, collection event logging, project.json curation.
skills.not_for: Reconciliation arithmetic.

skills.name: debtors-analysis
skills.canonical_for: Deterministic transaction classification, allocation graphing, timing variance analysis.
skills.not_for: Customer-facing output — it produces internal analysis only.

skills.name: debtor-statement-v5-from-txt
skills.canonical_for: Debtor Statement of Account v5 — Part 1A (LPG) / 1B (CYL) sub-ledger split with the 1A + 1B = ERP reconciliation bridge, Part 2 cylinder tracker, position summary.
skills.not_for: Combined-ledger v4 layout, or creditor statements.
skills.notes: Owning script is analysis/debtors/shared/scripts/reconcile_debtor_v5_from_txt.mjs, which has NO npm entry point — proven defect, staged as D5 in the registers plan. Invoked by absolute path until registered.

skills.name: debtor-statement-v4-from-txt
skills.canonical_for: Debtor Statement of Account v4 — combined Part 1 ledger (CYL Settlement Allocation layout), Part 2 tracker, position summary.
skills.not_for: Accounts routed to the v5 sub-ledger lane.
skills.notes: Predecessor layout to v5. Retained — accounts not yet migrated still route here.

skills.name: debtor-customer-statement-from-txt
skills.canonical_for: Customer-facing Statement of Account from DEBENQ TXT — ageing buckets, open invoice list, collections letter. No DATABASE_URL required.
skills.not_for: Internal v4/v5 sub-ledger recon.
skills.notes: First built for TWK002; generalised. Must pass the tag gate before publishing an open-invoice list.

skills.name: erp-payment-tag-verification
skills.canonical_for: Verifying ERP INVNO payment tags before an invoice is treated as settled. Owns the INVNO_TAG_CHRONOLOGY reject (invoice.tx_date > payment.tx_date) and TAG_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE circularity reject.
skills.not_for: Deciding allocations. It rejects unsafe linkages; it never creates one.
skills.notes: Added 2026-09-29. Complements business_rules.md §15 authority orders A/B. Per-account false leads in config/payment_tag_false_leads.json.

skills.name: payment-to-invoice-allocation
skills.canonical_for: Allocation doctrine for invoice-linked payers whose payments carry ref_no to invoice doc_no (e.g. WO0001) — exact ref matching, split STAT batches, rounding residuals, LPG-only comparison.
skills.not_for: Monthly batch payers — route to payment.pattern.analysis or monthly.batch.bridge instead.

skills.name: allocation-worker
skills.canonical_for: Cold-start session protocol for the invoice-linked allocation lane (WO0001 family) — Turn 2 pilot, building allocation_edges.csv.
skills.not_for: Monthly batch payers (JIM001) or settlement-discount accounts (TWK002).
skills.notes: Base worker. Account-specific workers extend this.

skills.name: bu0005-allocation-worker
skills.canonical_for: BU0005 (CHOBOZA - BULWER) allocation lane, Turns 3-5, including STAT-batch rounding journals.
skills.not_for: Other accounts, and not settlement discount — BU0005's residuals are rounding journals.
skills.notes: Extends allocation.worker. Assumes no local repo — clones first.

skills.name: lpg-payment-pattern-analysis
skills.canonical_for: The YYYY_Payment_Pattern_Analysis.md annual variance report for consolidated monthly-batch payers — amount-proximity matching, Pattern 2/3 offsets, Rule 13 surplus tracking.
skills.not_for: Invoice-linked payers, and not the point-in-time bridge — that is monthly.batch.bridge.
skills.notes: Kept separate from tag.verification by operator decision 2026-09-29. Defers invoice-level INVNO tag evaluation to tag.verification.

skills.name: monthly-batch-erp-bridge-reconciliation
skills.canonical_for: Point-in-time bridge between a commercial open-invoice schedule and the ERP running balance for monthly-batch (STAT) payers — exact-sum payment-to-month verification, standing-credit detection by constant-gap testing, CYL deposit-pair netting, calendar-month ageing, linked/duplicate ERP account detection.
skills.not_for: Invoice-linked payers. Also not the annual pattern report — that is payment.pattern.analysis.
skills.notes: First built for MD0003 (Bluff Meat Supply). Owns the exact-sum arithmetic that payment.pattern.analysis defers to. Applies to BR0001.

skills.name: creditor-statement-v5-from-txt
skills.canonical_for: Creditor Statement of Account v5 — Part 1A (LPG purchases) / 1B (CYL deposit shells) with bridge, Part 2 shell qty tracker, GRV/Deb Note routing.
skills.not_for: Debtor accounts.
skills.notes: Mirror of the debtor v5 lane. First built for 008ORY (Oryx Energy).

skills.name: human-sources-agent
skills.canonical_for: Human intake role — gathering remittance PDFs, ERP TXT exports, aged-debt reports, deposit screenshots into the correct raw/ folders.
skills.not_for: Interpreting the evidence it collects.

skills.name: human-erp-agent
skills.canonical_for: Human ERP/finance clerk role — posting journals, correcting payments, exporting fresh TXT, executing HUMAN_TASKS.md rows scoped to Role ERP Agent.
skills.not_for: Deciding what the correction should be — that comes from a worker checklist.

skills.name: human-collections-agent
skills.canonical_for: Human collections / creditor-controller role — payment reminders and LOD, portfolio queue prioritisation, recon sign-off before collection, ACTION_PROMPTS.md execution.
skills.not_for: Contacting a customer before recon sign-off.

skills.name: fam000-reconciliation
skills.canonical_for: Family Gas consolidated recon across ERP codes FAM000 (parent) and FAM002 (child). Owns two mandatory ERP bug bypasses: header double-taxation on credit notes, and up to 18 credit notes omitted from the printed statement.
skills.not_for: Any other account. Never query FAM000 or FAM002 in isolation, and never trust transaction_headers running balances for this account.
skills.notes: Relocated 2026-09-29 from analysis/debtors/FAM000/docs/ and given frontmatter (operator decision D3). It previously sat outside every skill root with no frontmatter, so its bug-bypass rules — which exist nowhere else — were invisible to auto-discovery.

skills.name: jen001-reconciliation
skills.canonical_for: Jennings Gas recon under the Stripped Gas Model — Part 1 LPG-only financial ledger with deposits stripped, Part 2 quantity-only cylinder ledger. Owns the JEN010 exclusion rule.
skills.not_for: Any other account. Never merge legacy JEN010 — it shifts the 9kg physical opening balance from -1 to +5. Settlement discount for this account lives in JEN001_Settlement_Discount_Doctrine_v1.md.
skills.notes: Relocated 2026-09-29 from analysis/debtors/JEN001/docs/ and given frontmatter (operator decision D3). JEN001_Settlement_Discount_Doctrine_v1.md cites it as Primary evidence; those 3 references were repointed with the move. Drives reconcile_jen_db_only_monthly_stripped.py, which still has no registered entry point — see SCRIPT_REGISTRY.

skills.name: lpg-recon-bug-fixer
skills.canonical_for: Root-causing data-integrity bugs — ERP import duplication, payment-allocation mistargeting, header/line-item mismatch, ERP-vs-computed balance discrepancies.
skills.not_for: Feature work.
skills.notes: Sole occupant of the .claude/skills root — loaded by Claude Code only. Agents reading .agents/skills alone will not find it.

skills.name: lsr-pm
skills.canonical_for: The two-phase Feature Pipeline — feature kickoff, LSR ticket creation, pipeline status, stage artifact approval.
skills.not_for: Debtor recon — that is debtors.pm.
skills.notes: Sole canonical holder of the name 'lsr-pm' since 2026-09-29 (operator decision D2). Supersedes pipeline.pm.short, which was the 56-line summary.

skills.canonical_for: Nothing — superseded. Retained only so the supersession is discoverable.
skills.not_for: Loading. It is marked SUPERSEDED in-file and its name: key was removed.
skills.notes: Superseded by pipeline.pm.full on 2026-09-29 (operator decision D2). Both files declared name 'lsr-pm', so which loaded depended on load order. The name: key is removed rather than the file deleted — amendments append, superseded text is marked. See DEBTORS_DOCTRINE.md D20.

skills.canonical_for: Product Manager role — backlog, scope decisions, PRDs, Jira. Writes no code, merges no branches.
skills.not_for: Pipeline stage orchestration — defers to pipeline.pm.full.
skills.notes: No frontmatter — not auto-loadable. Staged as D3.

skills.canonical_for: QA role — verifying implemented features against acceptance criteria pre-merge. Reports pass/fail; the PM decides the merge.
skills.not_for: Writing features or merging branches.
skills.notes: No frontmatter — not auto-loadable. Staged as D3.

skills.canonical_for: Coding role — implementing to spec on feature branches, never on main. Makes no scope decisions.
skills.not_for: Scope decisions.
skills.notes: No frontmatter — not auto-loadable. Staged as D3.

skills.canonical_for: Translating requirements and bug reports into Jira tickets and Coding Agent prompts.
skills.not_for: Production code or product decisions.
skills.notes: No frontmatter — not auto-loadable. Staged as D3.

skills.canonical_for: Updating ERP/customer price records after a commercial price is approved.
skills.not_for: Deciding prices.
skills.notes: Sole occupant of the docs/skills root. No frontmatter. Staged as D3.

skills.canonical_for: Platform architecture decision — ERPNext and Medusa integration boundary. Status Accepted, 2026-05-24.
skills.not_for: Execution. It is a decision record, not a skill.
skills.notes: A TDR filed in a skills directory. Misfiled rather than defective. Staged as D3.

skills.name: debtor-scaffold
skills.canonical_for: Creating a new debtor micro-project: directories plus a schema-valid project.json via debtors:scaffold.
skills.not_for: Ingesting ERP evidence, writing config overrides, or any reconciliation. It creates the shell only.
